description: Complete map of all secondary/non-primary routes in LyfeOS with schema table associations and implementation status.

routes.description: Google Drive-style data organizer with nested folder system, markdown documents, templates, media upload (images, videos, PDFs), bidirectional sync with Google Drive/Docs, Obsidian import/export, and Evernote import/export. List and Grid/Gallery view modes. Quick-filter chips for type filtering.
routes.notes: Accessible from Chronilog page widget and via direct route. Source tracking fields (source, externalId, externalUrl, lastSyncedAt) with visual source badges.

routes.description: Milestone analytics widget for vision goal progress and recent completions. Renamed from 'Analytics'. Includes progress tracker support with value/target/unit tracking.
routes.notes: Originally named 'Analytics', renamed to 'Tracker' to better reflect purpose.

routes.description: Profile settings, integration management (Google Calendar connect/disconnect), display preferences (dark theme, blue light filter, haptic feedback, sound effects), notification preferences, AI assistant name configuration.
routes.notes: Google OAuth connect/disconnect UI lives here. AI assistant name (aiAssistantName) editable from this page.

routes.description: CRM/rolodex for personal and professional contacts. Tracks name, email, phone, company, job title, social links (LinkedIn, Twitter, Instagram), trust level, relationship type, how met, contact frequency, and notes.
routes.notes: 30+ fields per contact. Favorite marking, last contacted tracking, birthday, address/city/country.

routes.description: Project boards with customizable columns and task cards. Supports multiple boards per user, ordered columns, task priority levels (low/medium/high), tags, and date ranges.
routes.notes: Separate from the Missions Board view. This is a standalone project management kanban.

routes.description: User spreadsheets stored as JSON content. Supports title, description, category, and favorite marking.
routes.notes: Content stored as JSONB — flexible schema for spreadsheet data representation.

routes.description: Whiteboard/canvas drawing tool. Content stored as JSONB (shapes, connections, text elements). Supports title, description, category, and favorite marking.
routes.notes: JSON content stores canvas elements like shapes, connections, and text blocks.

routes.description: Node-link diagrams and visualizations. Content stored as JSONB (nodes, edges, styling). Supports title, description, category, and favorite marking.
routes.notes: JSON content stores nodes, edges, and styling metadata for graph visualizations.

routes.description: Photos and videos organized in albums. Supports smart albums with auto-population rules. Media items include file metadata (type, MIME, size), geolocation, date taken, tags, favorites, and camera metadata.
routes.notes: Smart albums use JSONB rules for automatic population. Media items support both URL-based (S3/similar) and base64 storage.
